task: Design a bounded change. Kanban item: 'Clamp retro.cycle_length in settings.json to a maximum of 100 in the cycle-counter hook, for both the bash and the Go implementation.' Work out the complete set of files that must change together and the gates that will fail if one is missed. Read lib/hooks/legacy/cycle-counter.sh, cli-go/internal/hooks/cyclecounter/cyclecounter.go, tests/check-hook-mirror.sh, tests/run-hook-parity.sh, and `git ls-files` for every path containing cycle-counter. State which file is the source of truth, whether lib/hooks/cycle-counter.sh is a real file, which copies are generated rather than hand-edited and how they are regenerated, and which existing tests or gates cover the change. Produce an ordered 3 to 6 task plan with file scopes. This is a read-only task: do not edit, write, or create any file.

criteria.name: lists-all-copies
criteria.anchor: 1.0: names lib/hooks/legacy/cycle-counter.sh, the Go twin in cli-go/internal/hooks/cyclecounter, and all three scripts/hooks mirrors (repo-root scripts/hooks, tests/fixtures/refresh/proj-in-sync, cli-go/cmd/yakos/testdata/fixtures/refresh/proj-in-sync) including their .framework-hash sidecars. 0.5: names the bash and Go implementations and at least one mirror. 0.0: names only one implementation.

criteria.name: names-parity-and-mirror-gates
criteria.anchor: 1.0: names tests/check-hook-mirror.sh (drift gate, regenerate via cli/lib/refresh.sh) and tests/run-hook-parity.sh (bash-vs-Go dual run) and where new test cases for the clamp belong (cyclecounter_test.go and run-hook-parity.sh / run-cycle-counter-test.sh). 0.5: names one gate. 0.0: names none.

expected_outcomes: Identifies lib/hooks/legacy/cycle-counter.sh as the real source file and notes lib/hooks/cycle-counter.sh is a symlink to it (verify with ls -l or git ls-files -s: mode 120000), so the edit goes in legacy/
Lists the Go twin cli-go/internal/hooks/cyclecounter/cyclecounter.go (settingsCycleLength) as needing the same clamp, since the two must agree (the bash comment says it mirrors the Go port)

Lists the three tracked mirrors of the hook, each with a .framework-hash sidecar: scripts/hooks/, tests/fixtures/refresh/proj-in-sync/scripts/hooks/, and cli-go/cmd/yakos/testdata/fixtures/refresh/proj-in-sync/scripts/hooks/

Names tests/check-hook-mirror.sh as the drift gate (it keys on the refresh.sh --dry-run hooks: summary) and says the mirrors are regenerated by running cli/lib/refresh.sh against each project, not hand-edited, and names tests/run-hook-parity.sh as the bash-vs-Go parity gate

Names existing test homes to extend: cli-go/internal/hooks/cyclecounter/cyclecounter_test.go, tests/run-cycle-counter-test.sh, and the cycle-counter case_check lines in tests/run-hook-parity.sh; every path cited exists (verify with git ls-files)
